sections.dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS Adults: Dissolve 3 to 5 under the tongue three times a day or as directed by Lic. Practitioner. Take at greater intervals as condition subsides. Children: Dissolve 3 to 5 under the tongue three times a day or as directed by Lic. Practitioner. Take at greater intervals as condition subsides.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR If symptoms persist/worsen or if pregnant/nursing, stop use and consult your practitioner.
